title: Create stable URL slugs
prompt: Implement slugify in src/slug.js. It receives a string, lowercases it, trims it, replaces each run of characters outside [a-z0-9] with one hyphen, removes leading and trailing hyphens, and returns the result. An empty string or a string with no usable characters returns "". Throw TypeError for a non-string input. Keep the existing named export.
